# acme-rollup — reporting harness (Evidence)

**acme/acme-rollup** · Evidence `^40.1.8` · Node `20` (`.nvmrc`) · reads `duckdb` at `../../../data/acme_rollup.duckdb` · [the project's harness](../HARNESS.md)

The report is a subproject with its own runtime, its own generated/owned split and its own loop. It is a projection of the semantic layer: `dbt marts → MetricFlow metrics → MDL → queries/metrics/*.sql → pages/*.md`. Nothing here invents a number.

## Generated and owned

`pf report build` (also `pf tool evidence build`, the `reporting` bootstrap step and the `reporting` Dagster asset) rewrites the generated half in full; a stale file for a metric that no longer exists is removed, not kept.

| generated — never edit | what it is |
|---|---|
| `queries/metrics/*.sql` | one per metric, gitignored — the compiled query every page reads |
| `pages/index.md`, `pages/metrics/*.md` | one page per metric |
| `sources/acme_rollup/` | the connection and one column-enumerated extract per MDL model |
| `evidence.config.yaml` | the validated palette; never re-picked by eye |
| `package.json`, `.gitignore`, `README.md` | the toolchain and the rules |
| `../transform/models/_reporting__exposures.yml` | one exposure per page, so impact analysis reaches it |
| `pages/ask.md`, `components/WrenChat.svelte` | Ask the data — conversational analytics over the Wren workspace (`pf tool wren api`) |

Right now: 0 metric pages, 0 extracts, 0 exposures back into dbt.

**Yours:** nothing yet. A page you write reads a compiled metric query; a figure with no metric is a metric pull request, not page SQL.

## The rules a session is under

The `evidence-bi` plugin is enabled in `../.claude/settings.json`; its `RULES.md` is always on:

- Metric-first.
- Generated files are not editable.
- Never `avg(ratio)`.
- Palette comes from `evidence.config.yaml` only.
- Page anatomy, in order:

Skills:

- `build-dashboard` — Build or edit an Evidence page, chart, KPI or filter. Use for any dashboard, report or metric-visualisation request.
- `dashboard-loop` — Iterate a dashboard to a world-class standard — draft, score, critique, fix, repeat until it converges. Use when the ask is open-ended about quality ("make this great", "improve this page", "review this dashboard").

Toolkits on this layer: `evidence-bi`, `viz-standards`.

**Allowed without asking:** `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, `npm run sources`, `pf ask`, `pf report`.

## The gate, inside `reporting/`

| path | verdict | by |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/index.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `pages/metrics/example.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `pages/example.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `queries/metrics/example.sql` | **denied** | denylist `**/reporting/queries/metrics/**` |
| `sources/acme_rollup/connection.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `sources/acme_rollup/example.sql` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.sql` |
| `evidence.config.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `package.json` | allowed | default |
| `components/example.svelte` | allowed | default |
| `.evidence/template/example.js` | **denied** | denylist `**/reporting/.evidence/**` |
| `build/index.html` | **denied** | denylist `**/reporting/build/**` |
| `node_modules/example/index.js` | **denied** | denylist `**/reporting/node_modules/**` |
| `HARNESS.md` | allowed | denylist_except |

**This map travels with the change** (`harness_required`): a run that changes anything under `reporting/` must leave it current — `pf harness acme acme-rollup` — or the commit gate refuses it.

## Running it

| do | with |
|---|---|
| regenerate from the semantic layer | `pf report build acme acme-rollup` |
| score it (errors exit 1) | `pf report audit acme acme-rollup` |
| ask the same metrics a question | `pf ask acme acme-rollup "…"` |
| extract, then serve | `cd reporting && npm install && npm run sources && npm run dev` |
| the dev server `pf ui` → Review embeds | port 3000/ — `npm run dev --prefix reporting` |
| is the toolchain right | `pf tool evidence doctor` (Node 20 is the runtime boundary) |

**Loop:** `dashboard-coverage` — Score the reporting layer; find metrics no page shows and pages referencing metrics that do not exist. Cadence daily, level L1, read-only; a score under 90 is a finding.

**Dagster:** the `reporting` asset is downstream of every mart its metrics read, so a metric change shows its pages going stale in the asset graph; the audit score rides on it as metadata.

**CI:** no job of its own. `impact-gate` runs on models and sources; the exposures `pf report build` writes are how a model change reaches a page in that report.

## Gaps

- **A page edit is judged by nothing before CI.** `pf.tools.evidence` impact-gates `reporting/pages/**`, but `**/*.md` in `autoMergeAllowlist` is matched first, so the hook allows the edit and prints no blast radius. `pf report audit` is the check that exists; run it before calling a page done.
- **Every page here is generated.** Nothing under `pages/` is hand-written yet; the index and one page per metric are what `pf report build` produces, and the narrative a reader needs lives in the metric `description` or in a page of your own.
- **No exposure reaches these pages.** `transform/models/_reporting__exposures.yml` is absent or empty, so impact analysis stops at the marts and a page can go stale without a warning. `pf report build` writes one exposure per page.
